name: zvideo_fxpass3_config_update_local
description: zVideoFxPass3Config_UpdateLocal updates all local FxPass3 child elements and clears the queued slot count.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zVideo FxPass3 helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo FxPass3 source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bed30 validates the HudUiContainer::UpdateAll(deltaTime) call on the config object and the write of zero to slotWriteIndex at offset 0x1ec.
The native FxPass3 smoke verifies child update dispatch receives the supplied delta and slotWriteIndex is cleared.
